this_week.title: New risk: A westerly wind burst is under way over the western Pacific
this_week.why: The trade winds have given way for a week or more. Each burst pushes warm water down and east; the Kelvin wave it launches reaches the American coast in two to three months and lifts the event another step.

this_week.title: New risk: The world ocean surface: unusually fast rise
this_week.why: In two weeks the series moved by +0.10 degrees. For this time of year that happens in only 7 % of years.
